item: reader copies badge and Related leave out what an outlet repeats on half its pages
summary: Field test 2026-11-14 row 67 (report 7.1): one hbl.fi article showed ~12 unrelated hbl.fi pages as near-identical copies and Related ranked by 17 shared keywords that were all the platform's page text. Read-time only, nothing stored or recomputed (the mass import runs): the copies badge signs each doc without the word 5-shingles its source repeats on at least half of its 20 most recent bodies (after src.ingest.furniture.strip_furniture, the ingest's own list; cached per source 30 min; under 4 bodies nothing is learned); a doc emptied by that drop is never a copy (two empty sets have equal sentinel signatures). Related and the badge's candidate ranking leave out keywords on at least half of the source's articles (from 10 articles up). A story an outlet ran twice is on two pages, not half, so it is still found. Briefing and corpus-coordination clusters are unchanged (near_duplicate_clusters gains an optional drop_shingles they do not pass).
